newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - East Hanover, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - East Hanover, N.J..

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received by the Hon. Smruti Amin, Chief Financial Officer, Township of East Hanover, County of Morris, New Jersey, at her office, located in the Municipal Building, 411 Ridgedale Avenue, East Hanover, New Jersey 07936 at 11:00 a.m., on November 14, 1996, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale dated October 17, 1996 (the Notice of Sale'').
Time: bids to be received by 11:00 a.m., award shall be by the Chief Financial Officer prior to 11:00 p.m. on said
Interest Payment Dates: November 1 and May 1, commencing
Denominations: $5,000 each or any integral multiple

thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered officially for public sale in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

Interest Rates: The Bonds will bear interest at the rate specified by the successful bidder determined in accordance with the Notice of Sale. Each proposal must specify a single rate of interest per annum that the Bonds are to bear, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%.
Legal Opinion: Frohling, Hudak, & McCarthy, P.C. Roseland and Newark, New Jersey.
Pursuant to Rule 15c2-12 promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, a Preliminary Official Statement has been prepared and may be obtained from the Township.

In order to assist the bidders in complying with Rule 15c2-12(b) (5), the Township will undertake, pursuant to the Resolution and a Continuing Disclosure Certificate, to provide annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of this undertaking is set forth in the
Copies of the Proposal for Bonds, the Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and additional information on the Bond Sale may be obtained from the Hon. Smruti Amin,

Chief Financial Officer, Township of East Hanover, Ridgedale Avenue, East Hanover, New Jersey 07936, (201) 428- 3000, John G. Hudak, Esq., Frohling, Hudak & McCarthy, P.C., 425 Eagle Rock Avenue, Roseland, New Jersey 07068, (201) 226-4600, or Joseph Faccone, R.M.A., Samuel Klein & Company, The Newark Center, Newark, New Jersey 07102, (201) 624-6100.
